edition.notes: A dated Vatican delivery state of the Latin fourth edition (decree of 16 July 1999, Cardinal William Wakefield Baum, Major Penitentiary), including the praenotanda, norms, concessions, and the appended 1968 decree and norms. The delivery HTML exhibits minor spacing corruptions (for example 'EstRosarium') that are transcription artifacts of the web state, not the printed edition. Indulgence discipline is mutable; consumers date their claims.
edition.publication: Holy See Latin web presentation of the fourth edition of the Enchiridion Indulgentiarum, retrieved 2026-07-25
edition.title: Enchiridion Indulgentiarum, editio quarta — Vatican Latin web state

work.author: Apostolic Penitentiary
work.description: The Apostolic Penitentiary's official collection of the norms and concessions governing indulgences, first issued 29 June 1968 under the discipline of Paul VI's constitution Indulgentiarum doctrina, and issued in its fourth edition by decree of 16 July 1999. The fourth edition's norms (N. 1-36) and concessions (conc. 1-33, with numbered sections) are the locus system used here; the Rosary grant is concession 17 § 1.
work.title: Enchiridion Indulgentiarum. Normae et concessiones
